svg.title: Fejiro's GitHub public contribution timeline, November 2025 to November 2026
svg.desc: A dated public-only activity heatmap sourced from GitHub's contribution calendar on November 13, 2026. The bright animated marker traces recorded public contribution days. Private repository work may not appear until anonymized private contributions are enabled in GitHub profile settings.
svg.text: GitHub public contribution calendar · updated 13 Nov 2026 · see account profile for the live graph
